newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures rise on export buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures rise on export buying.

text.p: Castorseeed September delivery recovered some of its lost ground by gaining 5.0 rupees to 1,44.50 rupees per quintal (100 kg) on Wednesday on export enquiries, traders said.
Catsorseed September delivery fell 18 rupees per quintal in the last two trading sessions on speculative selling.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell further by a rupee to 357 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot, groundnut oil lost three rupees to 356 rupees per 10 kg.
Imported palmolein was quoted two rupees higher at 269 rupees per 10 kg.
